item.dreadmod.holy_charm.tooltip.1: Halves fear gain while carried. Stalkers ignore you.
message.dreadmod.night_begin: The night grows cold... something is awake.
message.dreadmod.charm_prayer: A quiet warmth chases the shadows away.
message.dreadmod.tombstone.1: "It does not move while you watch. Do not blink."
message.dreadmod.tombstone.2: "Nobody was buried here. Something was let out."
message.dreadmod.tombstone.3: "The light kept us safe. Then the candles ran out."
message.dreadmod.whisper.3: It is closer than you think.
